data.name: Nushaba
data.gender_notes: Nushaba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Nushu' meaning fresh and 'Ab' meaning father, this name represents the freshness and greenery of spring and gardens, bringing joy and delight to those around it. The name Nushaba carries the meaning “Fresh, Green, and Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nushaba usually hope their child will grow to embody fresh, green, and delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes new beginnings, growth, and renewal.
data.etymology: Nushaba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fresh, Green, and Delightful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nushaba total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
